translations.translatedText: # Tuesday 7.1.2020 (radio)

Many people have died at General Suleimani's funeral in Iran. In Finland a guideline has been made on treating a patient who has attempted suicide. Austria's Sebastian Kurz is now the world's youngest prime minister. There is a record amount of snow in Lapland.
## Suleimani's funeral
![Qasem Soleimani's funeral.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11146385)
Open image viewer
There were a lot of people at General Suleimani's funeral, and some were crushed to death. Photo: Atta Kenare / AFP / Lehtikuva
Many people have died at General Suleimani's funeral in Iran. Over 50 people have died. Over 200 have been injured.
People died and were injured because there was a huge crush at the funeral. A large number of people were pressed hard against each other.
The Iranian Qassem Suleimani died last week in an American strike. The USA carried out the strike in Iran's neighbouring country Iraq.
The USA killed Suleimani because, in the Americans' view, he was dangerous and was planning attacks against Americans.
Because of Suleimani's death, relations between the Americans and the Iranians are now very bad.
## Treatment of a suicidal patient
![A person supports a patient who is under care by holding their hand.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11144500)
Open image viewer
A suicidal patient needs good care. Photo: Markku Rantala / Yle
In Finland a guideline has been made on how to treat a patient who has tried to take their own life.
The aim of the guideline is that suicidal patients receive good care everywhere in Finland.
Good care includes the suicidal patient getting follow-up care after a hospital visit. Until now, some patients have been left without follow-up care.
The new guideline also says that the patient must be given a safety plan. A safety plan tells the patient what they can do if thoughts of suicide come back.
More people take their own lives in Finland than in other countries. Last year 810 Finns took their own lives.
Good progress has been made, however. Just 30 years ago, twice as many people took their own lives as now.
## The youngest prime minister
![Sebastian Kurz.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10995170)
Open image viewer
Austria's Sebastian Kurz is now the world's youngest prime minister. Photo: Natalia Fedosenko / AOP
Austria's new government has started work. The government is led by Sebastian Kurz. Kurz is 33 years old.
Kurz is now the world's youngest prime minister. Before him, the world's youngest prime minister was Finland's Sanna Marin. Marin is 34 years old.
## Lapland's snow situation

![Eevi Korva from Inari is shovelling her yard and hoping for a small break in the snowfall.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5184,h_2916,x_0,y_510/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6277605e0f2a46135a2/1578052287)
Open image viewer
There is plenty of snow work in Lapland. Photo: Jouni Aikio
There is a lot of snow in Lapland now. For example, in Sodankylä there was 74 centimetres of snow on Tuesday morning. Normally in Lapland at this time of year there is 40 centimetres of snow.
The snow cover in early January has never been as deep in Sodankylä's measurements as it is now. The measurements began over 100 years ago.
## The weather in the coming days
![Pussy willow catkins in Turku on 7 January](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11146677)
Open image viewer
In southern Finland it looks like spring. Photo: Vesa Moilanen / Lehtikuva
On Wednesday more snow will fall in the north, and in the south it will rain. The weather is still mild, and the temperature rises above zero in Lapland too. On Thursday the weather is sunny.
